book.title: Yeisu Wasane Dodohobine Metiu wana Luluweli

content: Yeisu I Liwo Bwele Habe Si Mwanalake Guwole Gagabubine
Sauge Yeisu i seyok Guwole Gagabubine i setagi nuwane i yogo, bwen wana topadavae si luwom heine ge si nga, “Gen matam i lok u paidi Guwole Gagabubine hana hao dodohobine!”

Yeisu i golase halingadiye i nga, “Guwole ya bwabwaligane mwage hu paipaidi. Tolosuwok a liwo heimiu, pak hebwaden si yomo ge si ginawi guwole ya hei, taine hotiya bwele i demiyemiye he habane, bwele bwabwaligane habe si mwanalakelake.”
Sauge Mwaomwaoine Hetutuhine

Yeisu i la i tihe sai he Bobokun Oliv ge i tuwodau, habeto wana topadavae hohowane ege si luwom heine si nga, “Gen u giyau lama wase, se sauge habe bigi gane lihuine u lihulihu-yan i youmate? Sohode hedi, lam luwom ge sauge mwaomwaoine hetutuhiine mwatan?”
Yeisu i golase halingadiye i nga, “Hu yehemiu, tab tolomo hotiya i egoyokapisimiu.
Kaiwane bobode si hoyowate bwele si luwom he hidau heine ge si nga, ‘Nau Mesaiya!’ iloke si yokapisiid bobode hoyowate.

Benan hu longe helolomaleke butudiye he hadidimiu ge hu longeik maleke wasane he hiyebe bwagebwage, age tab hatiyemiu i ebwalebwale. Bigi sohode-yan yake bwele si gangan, age sauge mwaomwaoine habe taine i deluwom.
Boda ge boda bwele si pelolomaleke-yanid, sohode hedi bagalogugui ge bagalogugui bwele si pelolomaleke-yanid. Buwota lahine ge mwaniknik bwele si youmate wabene tomase ge tomase heidiye.
Ngak hebwaden ya gen si youmate dei, sohode hab tilaoine gen i telipune muyai habe memai i youmate.
Bwele si bwangemiu, si hoteimiu he bagalase ge si tagapampamatemiu. Nau kaiwau bwen bobode bwabwaligadiye bwele si hata mamaliye-yanmiu.
He sauge yake heine, bobode si hoyowate bwele putetediye si giyau tapwalolo hana goru heine, iloke si waseyanid he-bwaidiye tologugui heidiye ge si hata mamaliye-yanid.
Profet yoyokapisidiye si hoyowate bwele si youmate bwen bobode hoyowate bwele si yokapisiid.
Page ngakngakine bwele i ekaikai la ege, bwen bobode si hoyowate wedi nunuwane he-bwaidiye heidiye bwele i tankai,
agegene sega hebe i talmidi gaigaisi hana had he bagapamwao hei, bwele mwad i paidi.
Bwele si papalapu-yan Helak wana bagalogugui wasane dodohobine he panayawi malemaleine ge bobode he wabene bwabwaligane si lapu, habeto sauge mwaomwaoine i sevin.
Ngak Lahine Habe I Gan
‘Tobagapangek bwebwehihiine’ gane veto Daniyel i lihuyan habe hu paidi i talmidi he Guwole Gagabubine—humiu hebwaden buk ya hana topahuwone gen nuwamiu i sapu lihulihu ya kaiwane.
Bwen he sauge yake hebwaden si miyemiye he Judiya gen si iwowo si la si sesai he bobokun.
Hebe tolomo hotiya mwage i miyemiye he wana guwole pwatane gane si gino pamalemale, tab i esedau ge i esetuk he wana guwole ge i ehowo bigi hotiya, i iwowo ege.
Hebe tolomo hotiya mwage i kaikaiwo he baguye, tab i esehavile he hiyebe ge i ehowo hana kaliko hotiya.
He sauge yake hei bwele i puyowo suwok venakau tomatabuwon ge topapasui heidiye. Eeu, heto ngak geb ti yake!
Gen hu hawanun Helak heine tab tuitui he hana sauge o hebe Sabat ge hu eiwowo.

Kaiwane he sauge yake dogobole lahine suwok bwele i youmate, sosohode yake taine sauge hotiya i edeyoumate he panayawi hana bagatelipune hana had sauge ya. Sohode hedi taine bwele i edegan sauge muyai.
Akum Helak taine i depahubo ngak yake hana sauge, bwen taine tolomo hotiya bwele i demwad. Age bobode hebwaden hobak i haseid kaiwadiye te sauge hana mwalao habe i pahubo.
He sauge yake hebe tolomo hotiya i liwo heimiu i nga, ‘Hu paidi, Keriso tage iyeya,’ o hebe hotiya hedi i nga, ‘Iye tage iyeyake,’ tab hu egoru heine.

Kaiwane keriso yoyokapisidiye ge profet yoyokapisidiye habe bwele si youmate ge si ginawiid pamali yauyawate bobode wedi baganuwo hape, nuwadiye si yokapisiid Helak wana hasehase bobodeidiye, age taine bosowaidiye.
Iyete hu nuwahasik! A giyau pasuwae lemi wase ti ya.
Hebe tolomo hotiya i liwo heimiu i nga, ‘Iye mwage te he huyahai yake,’ tab hu elok, o hebe hotiya i nga, ‘Iye mwage te he guwole ya gamwane,’ tab hu egoru heine.
Kaiwane Tolomo Natune wana luwom bwele sohode pilame, i piklame natek ge wayayane i la i sevin pok.
Sohode hedi, hebe buwonge i miye igohoi, bwen habekik kovak si lok ge si segin pase.
Tolomo Natune wana Luwom
Dogobole yake he hana bagapamwao hei, bwele parae i gogou, wahiyene taine hedi i detale, sinanane bwele si mamapup he bulubulu si sopiyele, ge togaisi hebwaden he hauhawal si lutulutu.

He sauge yake Tolomo Natune wana luwom hetutuhine bwele i youmate he bulubulu. Tomipanayawi bwabwaligadiye bwele si tantan, ge si paidi Tolomo Natune i eluwom he yaluyalu pwatane, bwaine wana gaisi ge wana wasewase.

Habeto bwagigi halingane lahine si wi bwen i patileid wana anelose-yan si la he panayawi bebene ho-pak ge si yomo paseid wana hasehase bobodeidiye, si telipune he panayawi busune hotiya ge si la si pwamwao he busune hotiya.
Hu Ho Bagalapu he Fig
Hu ho bagalapu he hibwahi fig hei. Sauge hebe ta paidi damwane i titi, bwen ta lapu dayave hana sauge hobak i sepasepase.
Sohode hedi, sauge hebe hu paidi bigi bwabwaligane gane a lihuyanid si youmate, bwen hu lapu Tolomo Natune wana sauge luwom hobak i sepasepase suwok.
Tolosuwok a liwo heimiu, sai hebwaden ya taine bwele si demate mwao, bwen bigi bwabwaligane hebwaden ya si youmate.
Bulubulu ge panayawi bwele si mwao, agegene nau lo lihulihu taine bwele i edemwao.
Taine Tolomo Hotiya I Delapu Yeisu wana Sauge Sehavileim
Taine tolomo hotiya i delapu se yan o hebe se sauge. Bwagane anelose-yan he bulubulu, taine si delapu, ge nau hedi Natune taine a delapu, Tamau ege i lapu.
Sohode veto Nowa he wana sauge, bwele sohode hedi Tolomo Natune wana luwom he hana sauge hei.
Saugeine habe taine gungun i desai, bobode si hagahaga, si lolomunmun ge si lolohadhaduwe, si pagan sohode ti yake hana had Nowa i la i setuk he wage gamwane.
Taine hotiya i denunuwotu heto sahe habe bwele i gan, hana had gungun i sai, bwabwaligadiye si matadau ge si mate. Bwele sohode hedi ti yo Tolomo Natune he wana luwom hei.
He sauge yake, bobode si he-iwo si kaikaiwo he baguye, hotiya si ho yogoyan, hotiya i miye.
Venakau si yuhun-iwo si kaikaiwo si hoho wit hinone nahadiye kaiwane, hotiya si ho yogoyan, hotiya i miye.
Iyete hu yehemiu, kaiwane taine hu delapu se yan bwele lemi Guyau i luwom.
Hu nuwohasik ti ya: akum hebe guwole tonuwagane i lapu se sauge he gogou bwele tobwahiyewo i luwom, iloke i matalale ge i topahad tab tobwahiyewo i elake wana guwole ge i esetuk.
Hu lovivine-yanmiu, kaiwane Tolomo Natune wana luwom bwele hatiyemiu i pahan, sauge gane taine hu delapu te bwele i sevin.
Tokaiwo Sensenapuine ge Tokaiwo Boliboliine
Akum humiu sohode tokaiwo sensenapuine ge wana nuwotu i sapu, gane wana guyau i hotei i matahasikid tokaiwo bwabwaligadiye ge i giyau nahadiye he hana sauge suwok.
Sauge hebe wana guyau i sehavileim ge i paidi i ginginawi kaiwo ya, bwele i hawa dohoban.
Tolosuwok a liwo heimiu, bwele wana guyau i hotei i matahasikid wana bigi bwabwaligane.
Agegene mwatan hebe tokaiwo yake i boliboli ge i nunuwotu he hatiyene i nga, ‘Lo gamalak taine bwele habekik i desehavileim,’
bwen i telipune i rabrabik-anid wana pan tokaiwo ge he-bwaine tomunmun si hanhan ge si lomunmun?
Bwele wana guyau i sehavileim ge i pahan hatiyene, kaiwane taine i delapu wana sehavileim hana yan ge hana sauge.
Bwele i tagapangpangek-an tokaiwo ya, ge i ho tukan he toyoyokapis hedi bagalase, bwele i mitantan ge ngingine i sangsangapatad.”

footnotes.text: Judiya wedi ganahao hei sohode ti yo. Saisai wada ganahao hei, hebe ta paidi kankandidi damwane si rabobu ge si rorobabe habe si titi, bwen ta lapu yamuwod hana sauge.
